Game Overview

Frog Byte is a arcade title where chomp your way to victory as a hungry toad in Frog Byte. Tap to catch delicious insects while dodging tricky bombs. Simple gestures, a buzzing swamp, and escalating challenges keep you on your toes. Hone your reflexes, climb the leaderboard, and share your top scores with friends!
